options.text: Easy. They are the same kind of group, and like joins like.
Hard. Each phosphate is negative, and pushing a negative onto a chain of negatives is uphill. The joined chain sits high on the Hill.
Impossible. Three negatives can never be next to each other.

image.alt: Phosphate groups drawn as an orange sphere with four red oxygens carrying a charge glow, two already chained and a third being pushed on.
